excluded_modules.optuna.integration: Third-party framework callbacks are scoped out-of-scope and discharged by radia_optuna.bridge. optuna.integration also raises on attribute access for any integration whose backend is absent, so recording its defaults would make the oracle depend on optional third-party installs.
excluded_modules.optuna.visualization: Plotting is scoped out-of-scope; the study is exported and plotted from Python.
